name: Line fit
description: Fits a straight line y = a + bx to measured points by least squares and plots points, line and the numbers.

capabilities.title: Fit a line
capabilities.description: Least-squares fit of y = a + bx to the points; draws axes, the points, the fitted line and a card with slope, intercept and R squared. Makes a new canvas unless one is given.

examples.description: A vertical line cannot be fitted

profile.whenToUse: You have measured (x, y) pairs and want the best straight line through them and how well it fits.
profile.whenNotToUse: The relation is clearly curved; R squared will be low and the line misleading.

reliability.note: Ordinary least squares in double precision, printed to 9 decimals.
reliability.verify: Check R squared; refit without outliers if it is low.
